about: Ratita Preview Center data (see PREVIEW.md). Builders edit this file: 'items' feed the posters + the Scheduled Additions board, 'previews' feed the Time Jumper. Live GitHub issue labels override 'stage' when the arcade is online, except that an item marked 'shipped' here stays shipped (issues are sometimes left open after release). Keep items newest first.

items.name: Grok Arcade: Education Center (Lilith the Bot)
items.what: Walk-in classroom with Lilith the Bot (made by Ratita Industries, tested by Tortuga Tech, on speakerphone with Lily the Bot), 4 subject stations, all 5 pets, Lesson Save Vault + submit-your-own Google Slides lessons, slideshows with Fun Facts + bonus questions, timed quizzes, Soccer goal/red-card quiz and Candy & Torty's free Tutor Pass.

items.name: Carrie’s Gift Booth (live)
items.what: Gary’s daughter Carrie opens her pastel-pink & gold Gift Booth in the southwest corner of the Main Floor (Menu > Carrie’s Gift Booth)! Features the Ratita × Tortuga Gift-O-Matic 3000 capsule tower, Daily Gift Capsules with a 7-Day Streak Ladder, 6 Milestone Gift Boxes synced with Bob’s Account Desk, 11 Gift Collector Badges, and interactive Pet Crew Gift Helpers (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy & Torty). Live now in Grok Arcade! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Pickleball Park: Drive Dillers Expansion (live)
items.what: Walk-in Drive Dillers Indoor Pickleball Center on the east avenue of Grok Pickleball Park! 3 climate-controlled indoor courts, Director Snowie’s 3-round Indoor Tournament for the Golden Dill Cup, and Courts Manager Lola & Candy’s Indoor & Silent Serve Foam Ball rule (bring an outdoor 40-hole ball indoors and Candy barks & steals it while Lola kicks you out!). 75 tickets at the DLC Machine. Live now in Grok Pickleball Park! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Voxels: Respawn & Joystick Reset Button (live)
items.what: Adds an always-accessible ↻ RESPAWN button under the minimap next to the 1ST/3RD camera toggle (plus K key shortcut) that resets any stuck digital joystick/touch/key state and respawns you at your latest checkpoint without losing a life. Playable now in the Time Jumper!

items.name: Grok Brawl: Controls & Jump Button QoL (live)
items.what: Moves and enlarges the ▲ JUMP button into the primary bottom-right thumb position (matching Brawler Tale), reorganizes PUNCH/KICK/DASH/BLOCK/SPECIAL/SUPER into a clean non-overlapping thumb arc, and fixes joystick up-tilt locking out the JUMP button so ground, double, and triple jumps always register while moving. Playable now in the Time Jumper!

items.name: Grocery Tycoon: Grok Van & Torty’s Tow Touch Fix (live)
items.what: Raises the driving HUD (#dr52, #dSide, #sd52) above the full-screen #touchZone overlay so mobile taps on Torty’s Tow, Hop Out, Honk, and pedals are never swallowed by the left thumb-stick, releases any held stick on breakdown, and displays a centered Breakdown recovery card with a Torty’s Tow button. Playable now in the Time Jumper!

items.name: Grok Blocks: Re-Blocked — Jeep Spawn Fix (live)
items.what: Moves the Base Camp jeep/truck spawn to a clear plaza road spot (4.5, 3.5) away from the southeast bench & lamp post, adds snapTruckClear() so the Jeep never spawns overlapping solid props in Ranger or Poacher mode, and allows turning while throttled at low speed. Playable now in the Time Jumper!

items.name: Retro Central (1995) (live)
items.what: Retro Central (1995) is live in Grok Arcade! Walk the neon 1995 mall, buy 6 consoles (1983–1995) at Gary's Console Stand with your real tickets, set them up in your walk-in Retro Home around a big CRT TV, and play 7 games: Super Torty 64, Speed Rat 1991, Speed Rat 2: Spin Dash, 8-Bit Plumber Bros. '85, Chrono Cheese, Shell Fighter '95 and Cyber-Maze '95. All 5 pets show up in 90s outfits. Find it in Mimi's Time Lab: walk through the purple ⏳ door next to Mimi's desk on the Arcade Floor (or ask Mimi's Navigator) and step into the swirling Retro Central portal. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Grocery Tycoon: Store & Delivery Fixes (live)
items.what: Dense, tidy Main St store, Grok Van signs (Test Ride / Deliver) at the Ship Center and Main St, all 5 pets on the job (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy, Torty), real van/freezer damage with refunds and rating drops, paid repair or Candy & Torty's 100% Free Emergency Rebuild, a walk-in Player Home with cooking, Customer Mode, and a $150,000 Halloween bonus that pays off your debt. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Eatsville Tycoon: Online Order Mode DLC (live)
items.what: Online Order Dispatch counter & Curbside Pickup shelf inside your restaurant with all 5 family pets (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy & Torty)! Take Tortuga Eats / Ratita Rush app orders: prep, seal in a thermal hot bag, hand over curbside or dispatch same-day delivery on your restaurant-matched scooter or thermal cruiser. Hot food earns big tips 🤑, cold food costs rating, refunds and gear wear, and Candy & Torty's free Emergency Reboot means you're never stuck. Live now in Grok Eatsville Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Pickleball Park DLC: Super Smash Expansion (live)
items.what: Walk-in Super Smash Arena on the west avenue of Grok Pickleball Park! 3 themed Smash Courts (🌋 Lava Island, 🚀 Moon Base, 🍭 Candy Stadium), 6 OG Super Smashers (Rocket Rita, Frosty Fran, Bolt Bo, Big Bertha, Dill Dan, Curvy Kiki) with 2-pt Smash & 3-pt Super Smash winners, 4 Specialty Power Paddles + Silent Serve Super Foam Ball, 3-Round Super Smash Cup, all 5 family pets (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy, Torty), and Paddle Grit wear with Torty’s Free Emergency Rebuild (never stuck!). 75 tickets at the DLC Machine. Live now in Grok Pickleball Park! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Sports: Re-Commanded (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Live on the Grok Sports: Re-Commanded cabinet in the Sports wing: Turbo / Tempest Engine overhaul with directional sunlight, real shadows, Day / Golden Hour / Stadium Night lighting, all 14 sports including the night-lights Ratita Stadium and Ratita Cup, and Pet Mascot Parade.

items.name: Grok Land Party: Fiesta Expansion DLC Fixes (live)
items.what: Massive Fiesta World Overhaul! Added the grand 5th town Gran Pueblo Viejo (🏛️) with a Cathedral Clocktower, cobblestone avenues & fountain, 14 interactive carved-stone merchant shops across all 5 towns (28 items & buffs), 32 bustling 3D villagers & shopkeepers, all 5 family pets in 3D (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy & Torty), patrolling Chili Cart & Beach Crab hazards with Stamina/coin consequences, and Candy & Torty's Free Emergency Bailout (0 🪙, never stuck!). Live now in Grok Land Party! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Sky DLC: Super Travel Expansion (live)
items.what: Ratita Airways passenger travel (Economy 8 / Business 18 / First 35 coins), walk-in Super Travel terminal with customs & passport stamps, VIP lounge, weather radar and Torty's hangar, all 5 pets on duty, the Golden Wheel heist vs the Sky Marshal, airframe & gear damage with a free Never-Stuck rebuild, plus Zacatecas, Ambato, Cusco and Cairo. Live now in Grok Sky Remastered! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Heist Crew Remastered (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Live on the Grok Heist Crew Remastered cabinet in the Adventure wing: Tortuga Remaster Works upgrade on the Shadow-Light Engine with volumetric light shafts, Stealth Shadow Pools (-58% detection), dedicated Jumper button (🦘 JUMP / Space) & Sprint, ⚡ Shadow EMP gadget, Kevlar Weave suit armor, 6th Shadow Vault heist, Suit Integrity + Bail/Repair consequences, and all 5 family pets (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy, Torty). Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok FC 2: Part 2 (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Bundled into the live Grok FC 2 cabinet in the Sports wing: 8-Stop World Tour Cup brackets across the Grok universe, Penalty Shootout, Free-Kick Challenge, 2-Player Local Versus, stadium weather, and Pet Mascot XI.

items.name: Grok FC 2 (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! New cabinet in the Sports wing: full sequel to Grok FC on the HD Shadow-Light Engine with directional stadium floodlights, mowed grass stripes, real shadows, dynamic Day/Dusk/Night & Rain weather, through-balls, skill moves, and an 8-Stop World Tour Cup.

items.name: Grok Arcade: Online Play Update
items.what: Online Play HQ at the Multiplayer Antenna: 40 of 41 Main Games online (all except Grok Surfers per Lizeth’s rule, with a “Lizeth Says Otherwise” override toggle!), Auto-Online Policy for all future games unless marked “No Need”, Arcade-Wide Room Browser & 1-Click Pet Crew Party Codes, all 5 pets (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy, Torty) in 3D & Relay Crew, real disconnect/foul consequences, and Candy & Torty’s Free Emergency Signal Rebuild (never stuck!). Playable now in the Time Jumper!

items.name: Grok Great Rodentia — Part 4 (live)
items.what: Grok Great Rodentia is live in Grok Arcade! Year 000 1 shadow-light mystery across 4 districts of the USM crimson capital and 8 walk-in buildings: play Brie in Good Mode to clear the framed sisters, or Evil Twin Mode as Evil Luna, Evil Pi-rat or Evil Snowie. 12 conspiracy clues, Golden Gouda Wedges, 4 endings. Free Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie and Torty from National Ratita Prison and Candy from the seized RuffSources HQ. Find its cabinet in the Game Gallery (LIFE SIMS, south wall). Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

Year 000 1 shadow-light mystery across 4 districts of the USM crimson capital and 8 walk-in buildings: play Brie in Good Mode to clear the framed sisters, or Evil Twin Mode as Evil Luna, Evil Pi-rat or Evil Snowie. 12 conspiracy clues, Golden Gouda Wedges, 4 endings. items.name: Grok Voxels: Re-Voxeled (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Live on the Grok Voxels: Re-Voxeled cabinet in the Action wing: Tortuga Remaster Works Re-Voxeled 4.0 engine upgrade with up to 8 real-time dynamic point lights, directional sun shadows + per-vertex voxel ambient occlusion, 3 live shader modes (Re-Voxeled Ultra, Neon Overdrive, Classic), physical 3D ammo & ejected casings, 2 new biomes (Tortuga Bio-Dome & Solar Citadel), Exo-Armor & Weapon Core Thermal Jam with Field Repair, and all 5 family pets. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Ratita HQ DLC: Tortuga Tech Expansion (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Live in Grok Ratita Industries HQ (and at Gary’s DLC Machine for 80 tickets): Martina “Torty” opens the Tortuga Tech Inc. Wing off the East Atrium with 4 sub-rooms (Bioluminescence Lab, Shell-Armor Forge, Hydro-Propulsion Bay & Torty’s Corner Office), 6 NPCs, 4 Tortuga gadgets, the Reef Obstacle Course, and The Missing Blueprints quest! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Grid 2 (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! New cabinet in the Racing wing: high-speed sequel to Grok Grid with 14 circuits (including Tortuga Superspeedway, Indy Brickyard GP & Tokyo Neon Drift), 8 cars, F1/IndyCar/NASCAR/Drift series, Luna’s Garage Tuning, 3-tier Drift Boost Chains, Candy Pit Tow, and all 5 family pets. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Sky Remastered (live)
items.what: SHIPPED! Live on the Grok Sky cabinet in the Adventure wing: puffy 3D cumulus & anvil cloud banks with sunlit tops, 6 moving weather fronts (Clear, Scattered, Rain Squall, Thunderhead, Snow Front, Golden Sunset), a glass-cockpit PFD with live weather radar, and the Pet Crew Weather Station with Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty.

items.name: Ratita Rescue MEGA DLC: Old Town Lab (live)
items.what: The abandoned lab on Old Town Street built by Luna, Pi-rat and Snowie's villainous great-great-great-grandparents: Founders' Hall, Goo Works, Founders' Vault Live now in Grok Ratita Rescue: unlock it at the DLC Machine! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grocery Tycoon: Holiday Mini Pack (live)
items.what: You chose, so we picked: HOLIDAY DECOR, UNIFORMS and a THANKSGIVING AISLE! Switch every store you run to Harvest (Thanksgiving) or Winter Holidays decorations (garlands, wreaths, ceiling lights, hanging pumpkins or snowflakes, a pumpkin + hay or Christmas tree entrance display, and a decorated storefront), pick one of 7 apron + cap uniforms for your staff (and you), and stock a brand-new Thanksgiving Aisle with turkeys, pies, cranberry sauce, stuffing, gravy and sweet potatoes, topped with plush Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty. Mini Pack, 25 tickets. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon: unlock it at the DLC Machine! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Dr. Vic: The Sunken Lab (live)
items.what: You chose, so we picked: THE SUNKEN LAB! The glowing Old Town storm drain leads to a secret 1911 Ratita lab under Old Town Lake: the Dive Dock (mini-sub, moon pool, brass diving suits, sonar), the Aquarium Wing (glow-fish tanks, jellyfish, a glow-kelp farm, an observation lounge with giant portholes) and the Deep Core, home of the sleeping GOOCTOPUS. 9 new clues and 9 anomalies to film, seawater leaks that slide you back to the hatch, and a GO LIVE finale. Cameos from Pi-rat, Candy, Snowie, Luna and Torty. MEGA Expansion, 175 tickets. Live now in Grok Dr. Vic: unlock it at the DLC Machine! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Land 2 (live)
items.what: Grok Land 2, the first Grok sequel, is live in the Arcade right next to Grok Land in the Adventure hall! Three high-speed Boost Zones (Meadow Rush, Canyon Rush and Shell Speedway) with a boost meter, grind rails, loops, homing attack, air dash and S-A-B-C ranks; new worlds (Red Rock Trail, Mesa Mines, Ratita's Cheese Conveyor, Tortuga Tech's Shell-Tough Test Track); all 12 classic levels with better graphics; online co-op; and cameos from Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Tortuga Remaster Works (live)
items.what: David's idea: a new walk-in area for remasters, sequels and quality-of-life fixes, run by Martina “Torty” and Tortuga Tech Inc. File Remaster, Sequel, Quality of Life or Other tickets at the big Remaster Machine (electronics by Ratita Industries), watch the Remaster Board, see shipped remasters like Grok Blocks: Re-Blocked on the shelf, and visit the workbenches, the Shell-Tough crash-test rig, Tortuga Tech robots, Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie and Candy. Live now! Get there through the green Express Pod in the Grand Gallery.

items.name: Grocery Tycoon Multiplayer (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon now has co-op shifts for up to 3! Stock, bag, pack and drive deliveries together; every job or delivery a friend finishes pays the crew a team tip, and you see friends driving the Grok Van or truck. Live now! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Torty Town Multiplayer (live)
items.what: Grok Torty Town now has online co-op for up to 3! Explore together with name tags and solve the Sunstone mystery as a team: any clue a friend finds goes in everyone's journal. If someone leaves, everyone keeps playing. Live now! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Blocks: Re-Blocked (live)
items.what: The Grok Blocks remaster is live in the Arcade, right next to the original in the Adventure hall! A shiny new engine with soft shadows, a day/night cycle, the dark glowing Crystal Caves with a mining camp and lava, Blossom Hills, new blocks, mobs and tools, and the Pet Corner with Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty. Live now! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Sky Tours Multiplayer (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours now has online co-op for up to 3! Fly side by side in your own aircraft, or walk up to a friend's parked aircraft and tap Ride along. Hop out anytime: your own aircraft gets parked on the nearest pad. Live now! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab Multiplayer (live)
items.what: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab now has online co-op for up to 3! Host a room, friends join with the 5-letter code, explore the lab together with name tags, and every clue a friend finds goes on everyone's Case Board. If someone leaves, everyone keeps playing. Live now! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Pet Party (live)
items.what: Grok Pet Party is live on the Tortuga TV Network! A party game show for up to 4 players (room codes) or solo against bots, sponsored by Ratita Industries and Tortuga Tech: 7 mini-games in random order plus the Crown Chase finale, with Candy from Ruffsources bringing out celebrity guests. Play it in PARTY, plus bonus game #46 Buzzer Blitz!

items.name: Suggestion Booth & DLC Machine fix
items.what: David's bug report, fixed: submitting in the Suggestion Booth or the DLC Machine never reloads the arcade any more, your text stays until you tap IT SENT (resending a DLC idea is free), and the Suggestion, DLC and Lili's boards share one GitHub check, refresh on their own and say when they couldn't.

items.name: Same-Day Rush: Drive the Grok Van (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon: a big 🚐 Drive Same-Day button and a how-to-drive card from Pi-rat, so anyone can take the Grok Van out. The catch: a tight ⏱️ delivery timer. Late orders get the customer a refund and cost you a star (and a bit of store rating). The van is faster, but crashes hurt it more and take 10 seconds off the clock. Plus 🚐/🚚 Test Ride at the Ship Center: drive the van or the truck anytime, no orders, no timer. Torty's Tow and Hop out always work, so you are never stuck. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Multiplayer for Torty Town, Dr. Vic, Grocery Tycoon and Sky Tours (live)
items.what: Online co-op for up to 3 friends is live in all four: Torty Town, Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab, Grocery Tycoon and Sky Tours.

items.name: Grocery Tycoon Patch: Packing Help + Drive the Truck (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon free patch (David's idea #52): easy packing with floor arrows, glowing shelves and an aisle/rack checklist, a Stop packing button so staff take over, a $3,000 welcome bonus for new players (one-time gift for existing saves), and YOU drive the Ship Center truck (2-day shipping) and the Grok Van (same-day) to new spots past Maple Lane: Cedar Court and Riverside Apartments. GPS, crashes, repair bills and Torty's Tow. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab (live)
items.what: Grok Dr. Vic: The Lost Lab is open! A spooky Halloween exploration game on the brand-new Shadowlight engine: sneak down abandoned Old Town Street, find the hidden Ratita Industries lab and explore its 2 floors and 11 underground levels by flashlight (the Goo Factory, the Robot Workshop, the brick sewer and the Goo Core), film anomalies to go viral and uncover what Luna, Pi-rat and Snowie's great-great-great-grandparents really did. Play it in ADVENTURE, plus bonus game #45 Goo Cam!

items.name: Super Shop Online Pass (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon: your store goes ONLINE! An Online Store desk takes orders 3 ways: in-store pickup, same-day delivery (a shopper picks the items in your store, then a Grok Van drives them to a house on Maple Lane) and shipping in 2 days from the brand-new walk-in Shopsville Ship Center, packed with racks, a packing line, a conveyor, a truck dock and workers, run by Martina "Torty". Plus your own phone: check orders, call people to set things up, hold meetings, buy upgrades and more stock. Keep your star rating up! Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty order too. 75 tickets. Live now in Grok Grocery Tycoon! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Super Sky High Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours MEGA DLC: fly SUPER SKY HIGH (the ceiling goes from 175 m to 320 m) to three floating sky areas that change how you fly: Frostbite Isle (snowfall, gusts and ice that builds up on your wings), Ember Isle (a live volcano with thermal updrafts, ash haze and lava bombs) and the Fly High Arena, where you battle high-tech planes and copters in foam-bubble dogfights (free-for-all, or team up with Candy; Easy, Normal or Ace). Plus the Sky Highway boost rings, 6 Sky Gems and 6 new badges. 175 tickets. Live now in Grok Snowie Sky Tours! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Bigger Hall + Bonus Zone East Wing (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: the Hall of Records got cramped again, so it grows a GRAND GALLERY behind the Records Annex (the exhibits squeezed into the aisles move in, plus room for 14 more games). The Bonus Zone breaks through its east wall into a whole new EAST WING, so every bonus cabinet is full size again with room for 56. And meet GRANDMA MRS, Gary's great-great-grandmother and the new head attendant of the Bonus Zone: very nice, sometimes TOO nice (cookies!), easily sidetracked into drama, and her phone is always broken. Fix it for tickets. Live now in Grok Arcade! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Bob's Account Desk: Live Sync (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: LIVE SYNC comes to Bob's Account Desk! Turn it on and Bob gives you a 6-digit ID. Type it on your other device and tap YES on a linked one (with a match code, so nobody sneaks in). Up to 3 devices, see them all and unlink any. Tickets, prizes, DLC and every Grok game's progress sync both ways by themselves: the newest change wins, an empty save never wipes progress, and Bob keeps a backup before every update (Undo last sync). Share with friends lets a friend peek at your stats with your ID and compare (look, don't touch). Works offline and catches up later. Live now at Bob's desk! Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Pickleball Park (live)
items.what: Grok Pickleball Park is open! A giant cartoon 3D sports park built around real pickleball (two-bounce rule, the kitchen, side-out scoring): singles or doubles, easy swipe/tap shots, the 10-rung Park Ladder and 4 tournaments, the Stadium Court with Umpire Pi-rat, the Night Lights Court, Torty's Pro Shop, the Clubhouse, the Snack Shack and Luna's Training Center. Play it in SPORTS, plus bonus game #44 Target Drill!

items.name: Bob's Account Desk (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: Bob's Account Desk is open by the GROK ARCADE wall! Bob, Lili's long, chatty, nice-but-pushy big brother, gives you a 6-digit account ID + name. TRANSFER SAVE moves your whole Grok save (Arcade tickets, prizes, badges, DLC and every Grok game) to another device with a code, QR, link or file; LOAD SAVE backs up first and RESTORE BACKUP undoes it. Live Sync (3 devices, friends) comes later: it needs a save server. (Premium Platinum Plus still doesn't exist.)

items.name: Crash & Repair Patch (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours patch: the tow-drone now ALWAYS comes (crash anywhere, plus a TOW button), crashes dent your aircraft and cost coins, fares and passenger stars, a walk-in Repair Hangar packed with detail (paint booth, welding sparks, crane hoist, parts racks, Mechanic Brie and crew, pet cameos and Torty's Tortuga Tech crash-test lab), 7 aircraft to unlock (copters, biplane, seaplane, cargo, jet) with clear cockpit views and a copter dashboard, and a tidier world with runways, a farm, Rainbow Falls, a sea dock and a camp. Live now in Grok Snowie Sky Tours!

items.name: Grok Grocery Tycoon (live)
items.what: Grok Grocery Tycoon: run a store in the cartoon 3D town of Shopsville! Climb from courtesy clerk to owner in Career Mode or build an empire of 11 store types as the boss, walk into every store and all 9 rival shops, and run deliveries from your own distribution center. Play it in Hubs & Worlds, plus bonus game #43 Cart Dash!

items.name: Spookster Mega Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Pumpkin Hollow MEGA DLC: green sludge is bubbling out of a fenced-off site, and under it is THE GLOOMWORKS, a hidden underground facility full of mad scientists and spooky tests. Investigate who built it and why (and who keeps opening the sludge valves!), unlock 6 new skins, and play Spooky Mode 2.0 (BOO, HAUNT, VANISH, FLICKER + the Night Shift challenge, based on Grok Spooks' Spook 'Em). Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy and Torty visit. 175 tickets in the DLC Machine. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Grok Ruffsources HQ (live)
items.what: Grok Ruffsources HQ: a walk-in HR office run by dogs. Sort the mail, file paperwork, interview new hires, find 26 golden bones and solve the mystery of Candy's missing squeaky toy. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Grok Snowie Sky Tours (live)
items.what: Grok Snowie Sky Tours: fly Snowie's tour copter over a big open world. Tour stops, pet rescues, ring courses, and 9 packed walk-in buildings plus 14 cottages full of mini-games and chores. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Merry Events Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: the North Pole Event Center with live events on the real santaupdate.com calendar: the Annual Reindeer Games, the Halloween Party, the Thanksgiving Day Elf Parade and the Christmas Day Party. 75 tickets in the DLC Machine.

items.name: Merry Tracking Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: the Sleigh Port opens next to Flight Command HQ. Fly to all 5 walk-in Regional Tracking Centers, meet the Elf Supervisors and help set up. Fully online on Dec 24-25 with live Santa tracking. 75 tickets in the DLC Machine.

items.name: Grok Pumpkin Hollow (live)
items.what: Grok Pumpkin Hollow: a moonlit Halloween town with the Ghost Train, the Scream-o-Vision Picture House, the Bat Caves and Boo Row (10 spooky walk-in shops, each with an activity). Solve Who swiped the Moon Lantern? Co-op for 3. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Grok North Pole Village (live)
items.what: Grok North Pole Village: a snowy Christmas village with Santa, the North Pole Express, Operations Row (the Wrapping Department + 20 departments with activities), 80 real elves from santaupdate.com at their jobs and Wish Lists checked twice. Co-op for 3. Play it in Hubs & Worlds!

items.name: Fiesta Kits (live)
items.what: Grok FC: 4 festive teams with real 3D sombreros, party hats and flower crowns, the rainbow Piñata Ball and 3D fireworks + confetti on fiesta goals.

items.name: Cabinet animation fix (live)
items.what: Grok Arcade: the 6 Bonus Zone cabinets with blank screens (Ghost Lantern '83, Crumb Patrol, Bone Dig, Sparkle Car Wash, Patty Panic, Shell Drop) now have their own animated attract screens.

items.name: Grok Torty Town (live)

items.name: Grok Lost Relics (live)
items.what: A cartoon 3D relic-hunting adventure: whip-swing over croc rivers, sneak past the Relic Patrol (they think YOU'RE the thief), dodge boulders, darts and spike floors, solve temple puzzles and beat Professor Vintage's 5 crazy machines across the jungle, crystal caves, a clockwork subway, a pyramid and a sky fortress. items.name: Grok Eatsville Tycoon (live)
items.what: A cartoon 3D restaurant tycoon in Eatsville: work up from Mega Munch trainee or open your own diner, cook and serve, run deliveries, decorate your house, beat Mega Munch and Pizza Palooza, keep it spotless for Inspector Grumbleton and fix the Ratita gadgets. Explore mode, Golden Spatulas, co-op for 3.

items.name: Grok Rides Remastered (live)
items.what: Grok Rides rebuilt on the Tempest engine: a bigger map with a beach town and mountain road, lived-in walk-in interiors, smarter traffic, rain and puddles, 31 rides incl. helicopter, seaplane, hovercraft, ice cream truck, fire truck, tow truck, hot air balloon and the Ratita hover-car, plus bonus #35 Sparkle Car Wash and 3 prizes. items.name: Good Life Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Life Mini Pack: the Ratita Industries Gadget Shop with 8 working gadgets (Fix-It Hammer, RatPhone 5 drone delivery, Tablet remote work, Hover-Board, Bubble Shield and more) plus 5 Ratita outfits.

items.name: Midnight Express (live)
items.what: Grok Detective Expansion: who stole the Golden Cheese? 5 walk-in train cars, 6 suspects with alibis, fingerprint dusting, a clue corkboard, Disguise mode, co-op clue sharing and a big reveal.

items.name: Grok Pup Town (live)

items.name: Ratita HQ (live)

items.name: Pickle Smash Expansion (live)

items.name: Ratita Industries Super Pack (live)

items.name: Super Thunder Expansion (live)

items.what: Grok Sports Command: when a match ends you get the results screen and PLAZA takes you back with the normal camera. No more stuck sky camera.
